newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana bourse falls in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana bourse falls in light trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange index continued to edge downwards on Monday, dragged down by Ashanti Goldfields Company (-60 cedis to 21,200) and Ghana Commercial Bank (-10 to 609).
The Ghana All-Share index fell 1.18 points down to 361.61 from 362.79 on Friday.
Guinness Ghana Limited shares rose (+1 to 355) in otherwise quiet trade.
"This is normal with trading at this time of the year," said one dealer.
Trade was thin with 12,230 shares changing hands but slightly busier compared to 9,940 on Monday. Bids continued to outpace offers by 684,330 to 3,758,190.
